{{Quote|Okay Jokers, move it out. Corporal Trask, you take Besh Team.|[[Ran Harkas]]|<ref name="War 3" />}}
'''Besh Team''' was a unit within [[Joker Squad]], a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] squad in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of both the [[Fel Empire]] and, years later, [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. It was part of [[Company C]], [[Battalion 9]] of the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]] and its members were called '''"Jokers"'''.<ref name="War 3" />

In [[138 ABY]], the Jokers were part of the force sent by Darth Krayt to [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attack]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taivas]]. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Anson Trask]], a seasoned stormtrooper on the squad, was assigned by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ran Harkas]] to lead Besh Team.<ref name="War 3" />
